Name: Romanced NPCs in CC Ceremony
Author: cptnmatruz
Description:
[size=3]I always wondered: Why your paramour wasn't there for you when you're being honoured by the entire town for restoring the Community Center?

Now with this mod the villager whom you romanced will take part in the Community Center restored ceremony. They have unique reactions to how Pierre drives Morris away.[/size]

[size=3]Now on version 1.4.0 which has full support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], including the base game romanceables added to the SVE version of the CC ceremony event, and support for the SVE romanceables (Claire, Olivia, Rasmodius, Sophia and Victor). And a new CC restored event featuring other NPCs from Ridgeside Village for the base game romanceables, [u]if you have that mod installed[/u]. To see it, you must have RSV [b]but no[/b][b]t[/b] SVE installed.

It also adds a generic ceremony event to offer support for other spouses from other mods. The farmer needs to be married to that character for them to appear. The dialogue is generic so it may not fit if the spouse speaks in a peculiar way.

NOTE: Lance and Scarlett were added as romance options respectively on versions 1.14 and 1.15 of SVE, but due to them being available only after restoring the CC there's no way they can be present at the ceremony: [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?showtopic=7549946/#entry104980183]FlashShifter's statement
[/url][/size]
[u][size=3]To install, unzip on folder .../Stardew Valley/Mods.

[/size][/u][size=3]For the romanced NPCs from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] go to my other mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10261]Romanced NPCs in CC Ceremony RSV[/url]
